purpose: Pilot: does ensemble docking across water shells recover discriminative power lost in ADR-AIIM-075/076?

subset.selection: all successfully-docked actives + 50 inactives sampled with random_state=20260815

protocol: re-dock the same subset at the 3A water shell (4EIY_cut3_prepared.pdbqt, 4 waters), identical box/seed/exhaustiveness as the cut5 run
comparison: paired on the identical subset: AUC(cut5 only) vs AUC(cut3 only) vs AUC(ensemble = best Vina energy across both shells)
decision_rule_declared_before_running: pursue full ensemble docking only if AUC(ensemble) - AUC(cut5) >= +0.05 on this subset; otherwise stop SBDD rescue and report as null
